items.title: 16.8 Capacitor ki charging aur discharging (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 16.8 with Figs. 16.11-16.13 and Example 16.9 (PDF 76-77).

blocks.text: Bohat se circuits mein capacitors aur resistors dono hote hain. Fig. 16.11 aik resistor-capacitor circuit dikhati hai jise R-C circuit kehte hain. Jab switch S terminal A par ho to R-C combination V₀ volt ki battery se jur jata hai, aur battery resistor R ke zariye capacitor ko charge karna shuru karti hai.

blocks.alt: Circuit jis ke oopar wale taar mein resistor R aur capacitor C (plates +q aur -q). Daen taraf switch S terminal A par hai, jo neeche wali battery Vo ko loop mein lata hai; terminal B aik taar par hai jo baen taraf wapas jata hai. Teeron ka loop charging current ko ghari ki sui ki simt (clockwise) dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.11: Switch S ko A par rakhe R-C circuit (kitab ki Figure 16.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Charge hote capacitor ke charge q aur waqt t ka graph. Do curves sifar se dashed satah CVo = qo ki taraf uthte hain, aik tezi se (chhota RC) aur aik ahista (bara RC). Dashed satah 0.63qo har curve se milti hai; wahan se dashed lakeerein waqt ke mehwar tak jati hain jahan har curve ka RC likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.12: Chhote aur bare time constant RC ke liye waqt ke saath charge ka barhna (kitab ki Figure 16.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Capacitor foran charge nahi hota; charge aahista aahista barh kar apni equilibrium (aakhri, tawazun wali) qeemat q₀ = CV₀ tak pohanchta hai. Mukhtalif resistances ke liye waqt ke saath charge ka barhna Fig. 16.12 mein hai: t = 0 par q = 0, phir q aahista aahista barh kar q₀ = CV₀ tak jata hai. Kisi bhi lamhe capacitor ka voltage V = q/C se milta hai.

Capacitor kitni jaldi ya der se charge ya discharge hota hai, yeh R aur C ke hasil-e-zarb (product) RC par munhasir hai. RC ki unit waqt (second) ki hai, is liye isay time constant kehte hain. Charging mein time constant woh waqt hai jis mein capacitor equilibrium charge q₀ ka 0.63 hissa jama kar leta hai. Fig. 16.12 ke graphs dikhate hain ke time constant chhota ho to charge jaldi aakhri qeemat tak pohanchta hai.

Fig. 16.13 (a) mein capacitor resistor ke zariye discharge ho raha hai. Switch S point B par hai (battery circuit se bahar), is liye baen plate ka +q charge resistance se anti-clockwise (ghari ki sui ke ulat) beh kar daen plate ke −q ko khatam kar deta hai.

blocks.alt: Do hisse. (a) Wahi R-C circuit, switch S B par, yani battery bahar; teeron ka loop current ko +q plate se R ke zariye -q plate tak ghari ki sui ke ulat (anticlockwise) dikhata hai. (b) q aur t ka graph: do curves CVo se shuru ho kar sifar ki taraf girte hain, chhote RC ke liye tez aur bare RC ke liye ahista.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.13: (a) S ko B par rakh kar resistor ke zariye capacitor ka discharge; (b) chhote aur bare RC ke liye charge aur waqt (kitab ki Figure 16.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Fig. 16.13 (b) ke graphs batate hain ke discharge t = 0 par q = CV₀ se shuru hota hai aur charge aahista aahista zero tak girta hai. RC jitna chhota, discharge utna tez.

blocks.title: Example 16.9
blocks.problem: Series RC circuit ka time constant τ = RC hai. Sabit karein ke ohm × farad = second.
steps: Current I = q/t (charge ÷ waqt) rakhein: V = (q/t)R, yani R = (V × t)/q
Dono ko zarb dein: RC = (V × t)/q × q/V = t, yani RC ki unit waqt hai
Is liye 1 ohm × 1 farad = 1 second (ohm resistance R ki unit hai).

blocks.prompt: 1 kΩ resistor aur 100 μF capacitor series mein hain. Time constant kitna hai?

items: Charging: q aahista aahista q₀ = CV₀ tak barhta hai; V = q/C.
Time constant RC (ohm × farad = second); is waqt mein charging se 0.63q₀.
Discharging: q, CV₀ se zero ki taraf; chhota RC = tez tabdeeli.
